clips.title: The story
paras: In Pyrewood Village, Berard's Journal holds research the Royal Apothecary Society needs. Berard studied an ancient plague that wiped out the aquatic life of Lake Lordamere.

Before Arugal's shadow magic spread across Silverpine Forest, Apothecary Berard was one of the Royal Apothecary Society's most promising minds. From Pyrewood Village, he studied an ancient blight that had wiped out all aquatic life in Lake Lordamere centuries earlier. When Arugal's curse gripped the settlement, Berard lost his mind and became a thrall. His detailed field notes remained on a bookshelf in his quarters at the Pyrewood Village Inn.
